rules: Every public number on recommendedfirst.com must resolve to a claim here with status 'approved'.
A claim is approved only after scripts/marketing-claims-verify.ts --check passes and a person has read the underlying evidence.
Numbers are counts of captured answers with their denominator; never rates without denominators, never projections, never third-party statistics without a URL and date.
No prospect, agent, team or client is named. Domains of national portals and directories may be named.
Provider labels: 'the OpenAI model' / 'OpenAI (gpt-5.4-mini, web search, API)' and 'Perplexity (sonar, API)'. Never 'ChatGPT' for an API capture.
prohibitedWording lists phrases that must not appear next to the claim on any public surface.

openai.surface: API, not the consumer ChatGPT app

instruments.parser: mention-parser-v2+llm (classifier gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, verifier on low confidence, human review below 0.7)
instruments.citations: extracted from immutable raw_payload: OpenAI url_citation annotations; Perplexity citations[] and search_results[]
